description: Update an alert rule. Partial update of a rule's tunable knobs. `metricId` is immutable — the metric also pins the aggregation, so a body carrying `metricId` is rejected with `409 IMMUTABLE_FIELD`; create a new rule bound to the other metric instead (rule deletion is dashboard-only).

autoResolveMinutes.description: Close a stale live instance after this long; `null` never auto-resolves.

bucketMinutes.description: Bucket width in minutes; `null` restores the default 12 buckets per window.

composite.description: What a `composite` rule is a boolean over. `rules` are sibling alert-rule ids in the same project and `op` is how their states combine. A child's state is what the current pass concluded about it, falling back to whether it has an open instance — so a composite still means something on a tick where a child could not be evaluated, which is exactly the tick a "two of these are broken at once" rule is for. One level deep: a child may not itself be composite.

rules.description: Ids of the alert rules to combine. Stored sorted and de-duplicated.

delayMinutes.description: How far behind live the window is held; `null` drops the delay.

direction.description: Which side an `anomaly` or `outliers` rule watches; `null` restores either.

groupAlerts.description: Fire one alert per `by()` group. Refused on a metric with no grouping.

id.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

maxGroups.description: How many groups may alert at once; `null` restores the default of 10.

noDataMinutes.description: How long a `no_data` rule's silence must last; `null` restores 15 minutes.

inApp.description: Whether the in-app notification (the dashboard bell and Home) is recorded when the rule fires. Absent or `null` means on; `false` skips it for this rule.

notify.description: Delivery target for a rule's alert; `null` = use the project default. The `NotificationTarget` shape plus the in-app switch.

rangeMax.description: Upper edge of the corridor; `null` drops it.

rangeMin.description: Lower edge of the corridor; `null` drops it, returning the rule to comparator and threshold when both bounds are gone.

recoveryThreshold.description: What the metric must get back to before a live alert closes; `null` drops the hysteresis.

requiredBuckets.description: Buckets that must breach to fire; `null` restores "every bucket that had data".

sigma.description: Sigmas an `anomaly` or `outliers` rule fires at; `null` restores the default of 3.

sustained.description: Judge the window by accumulated departure rather than bucket by bucket. `anomaly` and `outliers` only; refused alongside `requiredBuckets`.

warnThreshold.description: The milder bound; `null` drops the warning level, leaving the rule with one.

name: ops_alerts_update
